title: sideritis ochroleuca subsp. antiatlantica
intro: Sideritis ochroleuca subsp. antiatlantica, commonly known as the Atlantic mountain tea, is a plant species within the Sideritis genus, characterized by its unique properties and medicinal uses. The Atlantic mountain tea has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, calm the nervous system, and exhibit antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis ochroleuca subsp. antiatlantica include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
